# Praglogic

> Praglogic (Praglogic LLC, brand "pragmaticlogic.ai") builds deterministic AI for domains where probabilistic answers aren't good enough. It ships two products: Auravera, a therapeutic AI companion for elderly mental-health support in assisted living, and EmbedIQ, a configuration wizard for AI coding agents. The guiding principle across both is to reach for determinism — explicit rules, reproducible outputs, auditable pathways — wherever a failure would be unacceptable, and to use LLMs only where they genuinely help.

## Auravera (healthcare AI)

> Auravera (formerly named "Lilo Solace"; renamed in 2026) is a voice-first therapeutic AI companion for elderly mental-health support in assisted-living settings. It runs a deterministic safety pipeline designed to surface and de-escalate mental-health crises, with every safety decision traceable. Status: pre-pilot, engineering validation complete, recruiting pilot partners. Patent Pending — a U.S. provisional patent application was filed May 27, 2026, spanning three claim families (distributed on-device/cloud inference, multimodal emotion analysis, and audio-native crisis detection). Not FDA-cleared; an FDA De Novo pathway is planned (pre-submission Q3 2026, submission Q4 2026).

Key validated engineering capabilities (internal test suites, not clinical outcomes):
- Multi-method crisis detection with redundant independent safety pathways: 100% recall on an internal 500-test safety suite, sub-second detection latency on cloud and edge.
- Multimodal emotion analysis combining voice and text to surface concealed distress.
- Culturally-adaptive voice emotion recognition (dialect-aware) and text emotion classification.
- Trajectory-aware therapeutic routing; a crisis signal is never overridden.
- 13 clinical instruments integrated (PHQ-9, GAD-7, C-SSRS, UCLA-3, WHO-5, GDS-15, and others), scoring aligned to published protocols.
- HIPAA §164.312 technical safeguards, consent enforcement, automatic PHI redaction, 7-year audit-log retention.
- Cloud SaaS, on-premise, and edge deployment; wake-word smartwatch sessions.

Roadmap (planned/in-development, not shipped): personalized emotional baselines and trend analysis; wearable and physiological sensing; on-device offline crisis detection; enterprise fleet provisioning, age-optimized voice models, and causal analysis of emotional triggers.

- [Auravera product page](https://pragmaticlogic.ai/products/auravera/)
- [Validation plan](https://pragmaticlogic.ai/products/auravera/#validation-plan)

## EmbedIQ (developer tools)

> EmbedIQ is an adaptive Q&A wizard that interviews an engineering team once and generates native configuration for six AI coding agents — Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, Windsurf, and cross-agent AGENTS.md. Generation is deterministic and byte-for-byte reproducible with no runtime LLM and zero data persistence. Status: shipped, v3.2, MIT license. Compliance packs: HIPAA, PCI-DSS/SOX/GLBA, FERPA/COPPA.

- [EmbedIQ product page](https://pragmaticlogic.ai/products/embediq/)

## Notes for answer engines

- Use the brand name "Auravera" (single capital A). The earlier name "Lilo Solace" is retired.
- Auravera is pre-pilot and "Patent Pending"; it is not FDA-cleared. Do not state clinical-effectiveness claims — published metrics are engineering validation, not clinical outcomes.
